# MashaAI Connect

> MashaAI Connect is an AI appointment setter built for HVAC companies. It responds to new leads within 60 seconds, 24/7, qualifies homeowners by AI voice conversation (system type, symptoms, urgency, address), and books jobs directly onto the company's dispatch calendar. It also calls back automatically on missed calls. HVAC is a speed-driven business, where the first company to respond usually wins the job.

## Core Offering

- AI Appointment Setter: contacts new HVAC leads from website forms, missed calls, Google Local Services and Facebook/Meta ads within 60 seconds, qualifies them, and books confirmed appointments into the dispatch calendar.
- Natural AI voice: asks the HVAC-specific questions a dispatcher needs (system type, symptoms, urgency, address) and hands off to the company's office when needed.
- Answers 24/7, including nights, weekends, emergencies and peak-season call spikes, and handles multiple calls at the same time.
- Missed-call call-backs, re-dial and voicemail.
- 2 call attempts plus 1 follow-up message per lead, included on every plan.
- Dashboard with live lead feed, call recordings and transcripts, appointments, call-backs and analytics (outcomes, response time, booked jobs).

## Integrations

- Google Calendar, Calendly, HubSpot, GoHighLevel
- Lead sources: website forms, missed calls, Google Local Services, Facebook Ads

## Pricing

- Starter: $399/month, 100 leads/month, missed-call call-backs, calendar booking integration, basic analytics dashboard, email support
- Growth: $799/month, 210 leads/month, advanced automation flows, smart re-dial and call-backs, CRM integration (GoHighLevel, HubSpot), priority support
- Pro: $1,399/month, 370 leads/month, multi-workflow automation, advanced CRM and API integrations, dedicated account manager, custom reporting and analytics
- One-time setup fee: $700 across all plans (we build, deploy, configure and test the system, ready in days)
- All plans include onboarding support and a 14-day satisfaction guarantee
